items.title: Orbital News 24
items.tagline: Life, seen from the last working tower — live.
items.description: Round-the-clock live dispatches from the watchers above the smog line.

items.title: Nightfall Protocol
items.tagline: The city sleeps. The code never does.
items.description: A cybernetics engineer discovers her own augmentations are rewriting her memories — and someone is editing them in real time.

items.title: Ember & Ash
items.tagline: Two families. One fire that changed everything.
items.description: Two estranged brothers return to the ruins of the workshop that raised them — and the fire that tore them apart.

items.title: The Long Quiet
items.description: In a sealed arcology where sound is rationed, a botanist begins to hear a voice that should not exist.

items.title: Vagrant Crown
items.tagline: A throne he no longer wants.
items.description: A deposed engineer-king wanders the scrap-cities, trading forbidden tech for a crown that keeps finding its way back to him.

items.title: Solenne
items.tagline: Some summers never let you leave.
items.description: One restless summer in a canal city, two strangers keep meeting on the same bridge at the same impossible hour.

items.title: Deadweight
items.description: A salvage crew fences a stolen android core and learns, too late, that it remembers everyone who ever touched it.

items.title: Tidewall
items.tagline: Built to keep the sea out.
items.description: The harbor defenses were built to keep the sea out. Tonight, they are keeping something in.

items.title: The Understudy
items.tagline: Whose name does the work carry?
items.description: A lab tech quietly perfects the experiment that will make his mentor famous — then decides whose name it should carry.

items.title: Cinders
items.tagline: It only burns what you love.
items.description: An illegal neon clinic promises to burn away your worst memory. It always takes one more than you offered.

items.title: Riftborne
items.tagline: The map ends where they begin.
items.description: A reverse-engineer rebuilds a war machine from a single recovered blueprint, not knowing it is rebuilding her too.

items.title: Salvage
items.tagline: Every machine here is dead. Until tonight.
items.description: In the breaker-yards at the edge of the city, every machine is scrap — until the night they stop pretending to be.

items.title: Grid City Live
items.tagline: The infrastructure is awake — and broadcasting.
items.description: A live audiovisual feed from beneath the skyline, where the city's data sings.

items.title: Low Tide
items.tagline: A harbor town with a long memory.
items.description: A canal-town fixer with one last favor to call in walks the long way home, past everyone he has ever failed.

items.title: Static Garden
items.description: A coder grows an AI in a greenhouse of dead displays, watering it with the city's discarded data.

items.title: Ascent
items.tagline: The one shaft the cameras can't see.
items.description: To reach the only working uplink in the spire, she has to climb the single shaft the cameras were never pointed at.

items.title: Crossing
items.tagline: The line he was warned never to cross.
items.description: A boy carries a stranger's package across a divided city — and across the one line he was warned never to cross.

items.title: Deep Field
items.tagline: Listening for a reason to stay.
items.description: The last astronomer in a sinking metropolis points her array at deep space, listening for a reason to stay.
